description: Resolved release-package contract consumed by Studium Labs ingestion adapters.
rules: sha256 and size_bytes describe the exact fetched bytes used by the package
mirror bytes must not be relabeled as official
canonical authority and retrieval authority are separate dimensions
reference ingestion requires a complete 1..N answer key in the declared allowed_letters domain
package existence never implies automatic catalog publication
sum-of-propositions and open-response exams are outside current Studium Labs scope
